encode_bbox_deltas: encode source bounding boxes into delta coordinates relative to ground truth boxes
decode_bbox_deltas: decode delta coordinates back to bounding boxes by applying transformations to base boxes
legacy_bbox2delta: compute delta offsets of proposal boxes with respect to ground truth boxes
legacy_delta2bbox: apply delta offsets to ROI boxes to produce shifted and scaled bounding boxes
review_LegacyDeltaXYWHBBoxCoder: review the LegacyDeltaXYWHBBoxCoder class for encoding and decoding bounding box deltas
